description: Plan id as sent by CMD team.
Prime item number. Same as item number.
Store number.
Dept number. Also called department.
Gate date. The date a plan is adopted.
Gate number. Can be 1 or 2.
Out of stock date.
On hands quantity. Also called inventory.
Projected On hands quantity for a given date. Also called estimated or expected starting inventory.
Avg sales unit quantity.
Original price (of the group) used for discounting. This is the price before markdown. Also called markdown prior price.
Recommended retail price. This is the price after markdown. Also called markdown price or discounted price.
Item sold unit at the recommended price. Also called estimated or expected sales.
Item elasticity at the recommended price.
Minimum feasible price based on Min disc percentage Min disc dollar amount and rounding rules.
Maximum feasible price based on Max disc percentage Max disc dollar amount and rounding rules.
Dollar markdown. The difference of markdown prior price and the markdown price.
Markdown percent. Dollar markdown as a fraction of the markdown prior price. Also called discount or just markdown.
Markdown spend. Dollar markdown times the starting inventory.
Weighted markdown percent. Markdown percent times the starting inventory. Also called wt. discount or wt. markdown.
Sell Through Rate (STR). The ratio of units sold and starting inventory. Also called just sell through.
Target STR (Sell Through Rate). Also called target sell through.
Gross Merchandize Volume (GMV). Units sold times the markdown price.
Initital Retail Value (IRV). Starting inventory times the markdown prior price.

Discretization of STR (Sell Through Rate) into bins of uniform width. By default the width is 0.1. Null and zero STR together are treated as a separate bin. Also called STR bins/ buckets or sell through range/ bins/ buckets.
